n: Elephant Robotics educational arms and AI kit
t: Desktop robot arms and an AI kit for camera-based object recognition and sorting.
steps: Visit the Elephant Robotics education page.
Use the business inquiry link to ask about price and shipping.
Ask the vendor which computers and software the kit needs.
Ask IT to approve the software before installing it.
Set up the arm, camera, and suction pump.
Open the visualization software and try a built-in algorithm.
Follow the first course in the textbook.
